Q: How many singers are from France?
R: SELECT count(*) FROM singer WHERE country = 'France'

Q: What are the average, minimum, and maximum ages of singers from France?
R: SELECT avg(age), min(age), max(age) FROM singer WHERE country = 'France'

Q: List the names and countries of singers younger than 40, ordered by age from youngest to oldest.
R: SELECT name, country FROM singer WHERE age < 40 ORDER BY age ASC

Q: List all distinct countries represented by the singers.
R: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM singer

Q: Show song names and release years for songs released after 2010, newest first.
R: SELECT song_name, song_release_year FROM singer WHERE song_release_year > 2010 ORDER BY song_release_year DESC

Q: What is the name of the oldest singer?
R: SELECT name FROM singer ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 1

Q: How many stadiums have a capacity greater than 4000?
R: SELECT count(*) FROM stadium WHERE capacity > 4000

Q: List stadium names and locations with capacity from 3000 through 12000, ordered by capacity descending.
R: SELECT name, location FROM stadium WHERE capacity >= 3000 AND capacity <= 12000 ORDER BY capacity DESC

Q: For each stadium location, show the average and maximum stadium capacity.
R: SELECT location, avg(capacity), max(capacity) FROM stadium GROUP BY location

Q: Return the name and location of the stadium with the lowest average attendance statistic.
R: SELECT name, location FROM stadium ORDER BY average ASC LIMIT 1

Q: For each concert year, show the year and the number of concerts.
R: SELECT year, count(*) FROM concert GROUP BY year

Q: List the names and themes of concerts held in 2015.
R: SELECT concert_name, theme FROM concert WHERE year = 2015

Q: For each stadium that hosted a concert, list its name and the number of concerts held there.
R: SELECT stadium.name, count(*) FROM concert JOIN stadium ON concert.stadium_id = stadium.stadium_id GROUP BY stadium.name

Q: List the names of stadiums that hosted at least one concert in 2015.
R: SELECT name FROM stadium WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concert WHERE concert.stadium_id = stadium.stadium_id AND concert.year = 2015)

Q: List the names of stadiums that hosted no concert in 2014.
R: SELECT name FROM stadium WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concert WHERE concert.stadium_id = stadium.stadium_id AND concert.year = 2014)

Q: List the distinct names of singers who performed in at least one concert in 2015.
R: SELECT name FROM singer WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert JOIN concert ON singer_in_concert.concert_id = concert.concert_id WHERE singer_in_concert.singer_id = singer.singer_id AND concert.year = 2015)

Q: List the names of singers who did not perform in any concert in 2015.
R: SELECT name FROM singer WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert JOIN concert ON singer_in_concert.concert_id = concert.concert_id WHERE singer_in_concert.singer_id = singer.singer_id AND concert.year = 2015)

Q: Which country has the largest number of singers? Return only the country.
R: SELECT country FROM singer GROUP BY country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: What is the maximum singer age?
R: SELECT max(age) FROM singer

Q: List the names of singers whose names contain the letter i.
R: SELECT name FROM singer WHERE name LIKE '%i%'
